2610.08229.title: Confidence-Ordering Reversal under Contextual Priors in Neural Decoding
2610.08229.paper_summary: Contextual priors improve neural-to-language decoding by reshaping candidate scores. However, confidence is read from the same reshaped scores, so the errors a prior leaves behind can become more confident with no change in accuracy to reveal it. We study how a prior shapes confidence in speech retrieval on MEG-MASC and MOUS using local decoding scores, a contextual prior combined by additive shallow fusion, and the fused top-two margin as confidence. Among initially incorrect predictions, we find a confidence-ordering reversal: a larger margin makes a repair more likely when the correct candidate starts near the top of the local ranking, but less likely when it starts lower. On MEG-MASC, pooled correctness AUROC is 0.87, yet AUROC separating repairs from residual errors falls from 0.70 at initial ranks 2-3 to 0.39 at ranks 21-50. Errors starting beyond rank 20, inside the reversed region, make up 46.6% of all post-fusion errors. We propose a score-level account: a repair must first close the correct candidate's initial deficit, limiting its final margin, whereas a residual error can build a large margin between two incorrect candidates. A causal intervention that changes only the fusion weight moves the reversal to deeper ranks as predicted. Under a word-level LM prior, it keeps moving after accuracy gain peaks, so a weight chosen for accuracy does not settle confidence. Reading local and prior scores separately improves selective decoding: the decoder answers on 74.5% of windows instead of 56.7%, while 92% of output sets still contain the correct candidate. Confidence after contextual fusion should retain the local and contextual evidence behind each prediction, not just the fused scores. Project website: https://confidencereversal.github.io/; Code: https://github.com/AmadeusFake/NeuDecodingConfReversal
2610.08229.paper_summary_zh: 上下文先驗透過重塑候選分數來改善神經到語言的解碼。<lb/>然而，自信是從相同的重塑分數中讀取的，因此先驗留下的錯誤在準確性不變的情況下可能變得更加自信。<lb/>我們研究先驗如何影響在 MEG-MASC 和 MOUS 上的語音檢索信心，使用局部解碼分數、通過加法淺層融合組合的上下文先驗，以及作為信心的融合前兩名邊際。<lb/>在最初不正確的預測中，我們發現了一個信心排序的逆轉：當正確候選者接近局部排名的頂部時，較大的邊際使得修正更有可能，但當它起始於較低的位置時，則不太可能。<lb/>在 MEG-MASC 上，合併的正確性 AUROC 為 0.87，然而將修正與殘餘錯誤區分的 AUROC 從初始排名 2-3 的 0.70 降至排名 21-50 的 0.39。<lb/>在逆轉區域內，排名超過 20 的錯誤佔所有後融合錯誤的 46.6%。<lb/>我們提出了一個分數級的解釋：修正必須首先縮小正確候選者的初始赤字，限制其最終邊際，而殘餘錯誤則可以在兩個不正確的候選者之間建立較大的邊際。<lb/>一個僅改變融合權重的因果干預將逆轉移至更深的排名，正如預測的那樣。<lb/>在字級 LM 先驗下，當準確性增益達到峰值後，它仍然會繼續移動，因此為準確性選擇的權重並不會穩定信心。<lb/>分別閱讀局部和先驗分數改善了選擇性解碼：解碼器在 74.5% 的窗口中作出回答，而不是 56.7%，同時 92% 的輸出集仍包含正確候選者。<lb/>上下文融合後的信心應保留每個預測背後的局部和上下文證據，而不僅僅是融合的分數。<lb/>項目網站：https://confidencereversal.github.io/；代碼：https://github.com/AmadeusFake/NeuDecodingConfReversal
